grading_7d.sql: SELECT scope,activity_type,count(*) AS n,round(avg(grading_ms)) AS avg_ms,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY grading_ms) AS p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY grading_ms) AS p95_ms,percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY grading_ms) AS p99_ms,min(created_at) AS first_at,max(created_at) AS last_at FROM attempts WHERE created_at>=now()-interval '7 days' AND grading_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope,activity_type ORDER BY scope,activity_type

grading_current_release.sql: SELECT scope,activity_type,count(*) AS n,avg(grading_ms) AS avg_ms FROM attempts WHERE created_at>='2026-10-14T16:50:17.578Z' AND grading_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope,activity_type
